evals.prompt: New feature: voice transcription with a per-user minute limit. Run the task properly end to end.
evals.expected_output: All phases of the cycle: 0) summary; 1) base (findings/search — has this been analyzed); 2) web research BEFORE code (how the industry does limits); 3) plan with a done criterion; 4) action via the base/LSP/CRG; 5) verification (linter+tests+live); 6) findings into research.db; 7) documentation; 8) report with the result first.

evals.prompt: I'm fixing the same deduction bug for the second time, and again it didn't help. What do I do?
evals.expected_output: The "error repeats twice" gate: change the method, obtain a NEW fact (log, dump, isolation, history) — not another blind edit. Then return to phase 2 (research). If stuck for more than 3 cycles — postmortem, rule into the canon.
